people.name: Jehoiakim
people.title: King of Judah, Evil King, Pre-Exile
people.name_meaning: The LORD raises up, the LORD establishes; from 'Yeho' (the LORD) and 'qum' (to arise, establish)

people.name: Jehoiachin (Coniah)
people.title: King of Judah, Exiled King
people.prophetic_role: Last Davidic King in Jerusalem, Exiled
people.name_meaning: The LORD establishes, the LORD will confirm; from 'Yeho' (the LORD) and 'kun' (to be firm, established) -- also called Jeconiah/Coniah

people.name: Shealtiel
people.title: Son of Jehoiachin, Father of Zerubbabel
people.name_meaning: I have asked of God; from 'sha'al' (to ask) and 'El' (God)

people.name: Zerubbabel
people.title: Governor of Judah, Temple Rebuilder
people.name_meaning: Usually read as Akkadian rather than Hebrew -- 'Zeru-Babili', 'seed/offspring of Babylon' -- a name reflecting birth in exile rather than a native Hebrew etymology

discrepancies.description: Eleven verses make Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel (Ezra 3:2, 3:8, 5:2; Nehemiah 12:1; Haggai 1:1, 1:12, 1:14, 2:2, 2:23; Matthew 1:12; Luke 3:27), and this tree follows them. 1 Chronicles 3:19 lists him among 'the sons of Pedaiah', Shealtiel's brother (3:17-18), and the Masoretic text and the Septuagint both read so. How the two fit is contested: the usual proposals are a levirate marriage, Pedaiah raising a son in the name of a childless Shealtiel (Deuteronomy 25:5-6), or Shealtiel as legal father and Pedaiah as natural father. Scripture does not say which.
discrepancies.theological_significance: Either way Zerubbabel stands in David's royal line through Jeconiah (1 Chronicles 3:17-19), which is what Matthew 1:12 and Haggai 2:23 rest on.
